name: td-scan
description: TradeDesk room scanner. Thin RoomPlan wrapper: a native modal hosts Apple's RoomCaptureView with a minimal overlay (photo shutter, room label chip, done/finish). Everything it captures, per-room parametric geometry, photo files with camera poses, room labels, compass heading, returns to JS as JSON; every calculation, drawing, and business rule lives in the web app (CLAUDE.md 3.2).
